notes.title: New Touches to the World of “Guns Are Funs”
notes.content: [p]Hello friends![/p][p]It’s been a while since our last update. Thank you so much for sticking around. We’re slowly getting back to work on “Guns Are Funs” and decided it’s time to share the process with you. Right now, we’re focused on revising the concept, storyline, and game design — laying the foundation for the adventure to come.[/p][p]Originally, the project was envisioned as several mini-games, but we’re now shaping everything into a more cohesive and engaging narrative. We’re keeping the toy-world atmosphere and core mechanics you’ve seen before, but making them deeper, richer, and more stylish. Story, mood, and style will be at the heart of our game.[/p][p]In the coming months, we’ll start posting sketches, art, and development notes. Thank you for staying with us — there’s much more to come![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45046714/80c3c715b9cb5516aaabd0a8c09d25969c02817d.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Development Pause - But Not Goodbye!
notes.content:
[p]Hi friends![/p][p]We've decided to take a short break from developing [b][i]Guns are Funs[/i][/b] to finish a few other important projects. But don’t worry - this is not goodbye![/p][p][b]We’ll be back very soon[/b], ready to continue with fresh energy, a new perspective, and more experience. We’re already planning new levels and exciting new game modes.[/p][p]Thank you to everyone who added the game to their wishlist, played the demo, and shared feedback. You're our biggest inspiration 💛[/p][p]Stay tuned - the best is yet to come![/p][p]With love,
The [i]3D Cube Games[/i] Team[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45046714/80c3c715b9cb5516aaabd0a8c09d25969c02817d.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Big update for the demo version of "Guns are Funs"
notes.content:
[b]Hi folks![/b]

We are happy to announce the update of the demo version of the game to 0.12. Most likely, this update will be the last one for the demo version, then work will be done on the release.

[b]Major changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] New levels and biomes for the "Guns" and "Escape" modes
[*] Significant graphic changes (post-processing, assets, animations)
[*] Updated interface
[*] Now the graphics settings, sounds, choice of subtitle and interface language work
[*] Lots of new music and sounds
[/list]

Join the game community in [url=https://discord.gg/NWNFTR3jAF]discord[/url], comment, offer your ideas, we are open to suggestions.

notes.title: Guns Are Funs: First Gameplay Video Released!
notes.content:
The moment has come — we are excited to present the first gameplay video of our game "Guns Are Funs"! Watch the video to experience the battles and some of our mechanics we have prepared for you.

Don’t miss the chance to play the demo — it’s already available! Your feedback is invaluable and will help us improve the game. Also, be sure to add "Guns Are Funs" to your wishlist so you don’t miss any updates or the release!

notes.title: Release of demo version of Guns are Funs!
notes.content:
We hope that you are ready to destroy a couple of dozen towers, because we are happy to announce that the demo version of our game "Guns are Funs" is already available!
You can shoot it now. But all decisions, levels and gameplay mechanics in the demo version may differ from the release version, which we are eagerly awaiting.

Play, leave comments, share feedback and add the game to your wishlist!
